item.tib: mkha' klong gsang mdos chen mo'i las rim kyi zin ris nyung thus gsal byed me long
item.coloph: ces mkha' klong gsang mdos chen mo'i las rim gyis (gyi) zin ris nyung thus gsal byed me long zhes bya ba 'di yang / 'di don la mos pa'i grwa slob 'ga' yi (yis) snga sor yang yang bskul ba dang / nye bar dbang ldan zhu yi khri chen g.yung drung dbang rgyal sku mched kyis/ zhu ri zhing du mdos chen 'dzug skabs bka' yi bskul ba la brten nas/ sman ri'i mkhan ming pa nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pa'i lung rig rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ sman ri'i bla brang du brtsams pa dge ba'i bon gyi bstan pa rab tu rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
